market_story: gas CC / coal: a deactivated plant is not a market participant. Grand Tower (511 MW CC, MISO-Illinois) sat dark from 2022 — zero CEMS output for three straight years, OS in EIA-860's own 2023 vintage — yet the retiree channel dispatched it to its paper retirement date of April 2024, and at 2024 gas prices the LP ran the phantom near its availability through the shoulder months where the real market ran coal and the model's CC class is availability-saturated. Dropping the units EIA's contemporaneous status marks non-OP (1,434 MW incl. Carl Bailey, Baxter Wilson, Taconite Harbor) removes supply the real market never had; Rush Island — OP and really running until its October-2024 deactivation — stays, dispatched through its measured window. No offer, floor or price parameter moves; the change is fleet membership on EIA's own published status record.
